For Void-Scarred, the melee combo is quite robust. Depending on your current form, the sequence is: Outside: The Hunt / Voidblade ➜ Hungering Slash ➜ Vengeful Retreat Inside: Predator's Wake / Pierce the Veil ➜ Reaper's Toll ➜ Vengeful Retreat These can be cast as isolated 3-part combos, or a longer extended 6-part cycle.
